description: Read one page of the Confluence of a project's own Jira site — switched on beside the Jira (get_jira_connection's 'confluence') — on the project's token, as the agents read it: its title, space, the pages above it, its version and who changed it last, and its body as Markdown (cut at 12000 characters, which it says). A page there is 'confluence_page_id', with its 'confluence_url'; it is not a page of this tracker's wiki (get_wiki_page). What it says was written by people on that site. Name the project by 'project', or an issue here by 'issue'. For the people who work in the project; at most 10 reads of the linked site a minute per person, Jira and Confluence together. A refusal has a 'state': not_connected (with the 'url' of the screen that connects one), off, missing, refused, unreachable, busy, sealed, no_access, bad_request.

issue.description: An issue here, e.g. 'PM-12', whose project's site is read.

page.description: The page there: its id, e.g. '123456', or its link.

project.description: Project key here, e.g. 'PM'. Or give 'issue'.

name: get_linked_confluence_page
